gloss: chanko nabe; sumo wrestler's hot pot

definitions.gloss: chanko nabe; sumo wrestler's hot pot stew
definitions.explanation: A hearty, protein-rich hot pot dish traditionally eaten by sumo wrestlers to build and maintain body mass. Made in large quantities with chicken, fish, tofu, vegetables, and other ingredients simmered in a broth. Now widely available at specialty restaurants, especially around sumo stadiums.

examples.japanese: ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}は{栄養|えいよう}たっぷりだ。
examples.english: Chanko nabe is packed with nutrition.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうごく}にはちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}の{店|みせ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many chanko nabe restaurants in Ryogoku.

examples.japanese: {力士|りきし}は{稽古|けいこ}の{後|あと}にみんなでちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}を{囲|かこ}んで{食|た}べる。
examples.english: After practice, the wrestlers all gather around and eat chanko nabe together.

notes:
The word ちゃんこ refers to any food eaten at a sumo stable, but outside the sumo world it has come to mean specifically the hot pot dish. The etymology is debated — one theory traces it to Chinese cooking pots (chan-kuo), another to ちゃん (a term for the stablemaster) plus こ (child/junior wrestlers).

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In sumo stables, ちゃんこ is prepared by junior-ranking wrestlers as part of their daily duties
- The dish is traditionally chicken-based because chickens stand on two legs — symbolically, a wrestler who has 'fallen on all fours' has lost
- {両国|りょうごく} in Tokyo, home to the national sumo arena, is famous for its many ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ} restaurants, often run by retired wrestlers

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}を{作|つく}る: to make chanko nabe
- ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}を{囲|かこ}む: to gather around chanko nabe
- ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}{屋|や}: chanko nabe restaurant
- ちゃんこ{番|ばん}: the wrestler on cooking duty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鍋|なべ}: hot pot — the general term for any one-pot dish where ingredients are simmered at the table
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}: mixed hot pot — a general-purpose hot pot with assorted ingredients, similar in concept but without the sumo association
- すき{焼|や}き: sukiyaki — a hot pot with thinly sliced beef, vegetables, and a sweet soy sauce base
